narrative_purpose: Teaches Earth's deep thermostat as a closed loop: CO2 weathers rock, the sea buries it as carbonate, subduction cooks it, volcanoes exhale it again — and the temperature-sensitive weathering step makes the whole ring a self-correcting negative feedback.
subject: A large circular loop diagram, four stations spaced around the ring. At the top, a cloud raining onto a mountain range. Following the ring clockwise: a river carrying the runoff down to a glowing sea where tiny shells settle to the seabed as a pale sediment layer. Continuing: a slab of seafloor bending down beneath a continent into the deep earth (subduction). Continuing: a volcano breathing a plume back up into the sky, which feeds the cloud again, closing the ring. A bold curved arrow runs around the whole circle to show it as one continuous cycle.
scene: A single clean ring-shaped process diagram set on a dark page, the four natural stations rendered as small painted vignettes around the circle.
camera: A flat, even diagrammatic overhead view of the whole loop.
light: Even diagrammatic light; the sea, the sediment layer and the volcanic plume picked out in cool glow, the rock and earth dim.
palette: Void-indigo base, the active loop in Pandora cyan and living teal, a restrained warm accent at the volcano.
style: Painterly speculative-science naturalist plate with strong diagrammatic clarity, hand-painted texture.
detail_level: Crisp on the four ring stations and the connecting cycle; soft and dim in the centre and margins.
composition: A big central ring of four vignettes with an open dark centre and dark margins for callout labels.
consistency_notes: Pure Earth-science figure in the book's cool palette so it sits beside the Pandoran plates. The single baked-in cycle arrow is allowed because the loop is the subject; do not add any other arrows or any text. Leave the ring centre and margins dark for labels.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no chemical formulae, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style
